$comment: Copy to backup-tokens.json, which is gitignored, and put your own values in.
This is where `pnpm backup:export`, `pnpm backup:restore` and
`pnpm guest:reset` get an environment's secret from, so that running one
names the environment and nothing else.
Each token is the same value as that environment's own BACKUP_TOKEN, the
secret its operator routes are behind. You invent it; a deployed one has to
be long and random, and anything will do locally. See docs/deployment.md,
local below matches what apps/api/.dev.vars.example ships, so copying both
examples gives a working local backup rather than a 401 - change one and
subdomain is not a secret - it is in this repository's own documents - and
is here only because it is the other thing a command cannot work out for
itself. local needs none, deriving its port from the checkout's path.
It ships empty rather than as a placeholder, and that is deliberate: a
truthy placeholder is accepted, so forgetting to replace it would send a
real bearer token to whoever has registered that name on workers.dev.
Empty refuses, the same way the two empty tokens do.
